role: external oracle for wall_resolution beyond normal incidence: 3D finite-element R, T and mid-plane fields of a metal block (P1), a metal circle (C1) and a dielectric block at oblique incidence, over a substrate, in two layers and at a shorter wavelength; the pre-registered criteria of the widened table are asserted against them

references.build: FEniCS (dolfin) 2019.1.0, gmsh 4.15.2, PETSc/petsc4py 3.26.1, MUMPS 5.8.2 (conda-forge), one thread, out of core

modified.description: used through its public Python API; the package itself was not changed

references.settings: Maxwell3DPeriodic on symmetry-reduced cells: at normal incidence a quarter of the cell (x mirrors perfect electric, y mirrors perfect magnetic walls), half the height split into parts even and odd in z (two solves); at phi 0 the whole period in x (Bloch periodic) and half of it in y, z split the same way; over a substrate the quarter cell at full height, one solve with the analytic air/substrate field as the background. s at normal incidence is p on the cell turned by 90 deg. Second-order edge (Nedelec) elements, 400 nm of air and 900 nm of perfectly matched layer above and below. R and T by projecting the periodic part of the scattered field on each diffraction order over an air (or substrate) slab. Relative residuals of the direct solves 3.8e-13 to 5.4e-12. Before the metal cases were read the models were checked against uniform slabs (analytic, within 1.2e-4) and the dielectric block (RETICOLO at order 30, within 1.3e-4); the criterion was 1e-3. The stored phasors are in gyptis's time convention, the conjugate of Wavebit's; the consumer maps them as sign * conj(E), sign -1 for p and +1 for s
references.discretization: tetrahedral meshes graded toward the walls and edges, two levels per case (coarser/finer: R1p oz 50313/104197 cells; R1s oz 50313/104197 cells; R2p oz 50313/104197 cells; R2s oz 50313/104197 cells; R4p nsub 51111/105016 cells; R5p nz 40624/94343 cells; R6p nz 25920/53070 cells; C1ap oz 42600/79280 cells; C1as oz 42600/79280 cells; C1bp nsub 43873/80706 cells; C1cp nz 19082/37746 cells; C1cs nz 19100/37495 cells; C1dp nz 33088/69597 cells; blk_d_n nz 25920/53070 cells; blk_d_o20p oz 50313/104197 cells; blk_d_o20s oz 50313/104197 cells), the finer with 0.25 to 0.69 million complex unknowns per solve and a smallest edge of about 1.5 nm; the product side is a Fourier truncation of the same cell

generator.command: python fem_sym.py <case> <level> with the mesh rule v2, levels 0 and 1, for each of the sixteen cases; then R and T of the newest record per case and level, and the finer level's plane fields reduced to their in-plane components in single precision

cost.note: the finer level only, sixteen cases; the machine shared its CPU with other work, so the time is not a cost measurement

cells.period_nm: 400 x 400, except C1cp and C1cs: 400 (x) by 300 (y)
cells.shapes: a 200 x 200 nm block (R*, blk_*) or a circle of radius 100 nm (C1*), centred in the cell
cells.shape_epsilon: -20+1.5j for R* and C1* (Wavebit's convention, loss a positive imaginary part; the runs take its conjugate), 12.25 for blk_*
cells.two_layers: R5p and C1dp: two identical patterned layers with a 100 nm air gap between them

incidence.theta_deg: 20 for R1*, C1a*, blk_d_o20*; 40 for R2*; 0 otherwise; phi 0 (plane of incidence xz)
incidence.polarization: the case name's last letter (p or s); blk_d_n is p
incidence.source: a plane wave from the top

values.R, T: total reflectance and transmittance on the finer mesh level (level 1)
values.R_coarse, T_coarse: the same on the coarser level (level 0)
values.E_<case>: in-plane (Ex, Ey) on each patterned layer's mid-plane, E[plane, j, i, component] at (x[i], y[j]); complex64; gyptis's convention, normalised so the incident wave has phase 0 at the stack's top and x = 0
values.depth_<case>: each plane's depth below the stack's top, top layer first

inputs.mesh_rule: v2 of 2026-11-22: PML 40 nm and air 20 nm elements at every level, refinement at the true edges and on the shapes' walls, top and bottom faces; the two levels differ only in the wall and edge sizes

outcomes.reference_self_check: u_F, the relative R change between the two levels, is 7.5e-6 to 4.0e-3 (above 1e-3, which the criteria call weak, for R1p, R1s, R2p, R2s, R4p, R5p, C1bp and blk_d_o20p); it is stored with the values
